To get your API key:

1. Log in to [Emelia](https://v3.emelia.io).
2. Open **Settings**, then **API & Webhooks** ([direct link](https://v3.emelia.io/settings/api)).
3. Create a key (or copy an existing one) and paste it here. It is 48 characters long.
